sources.title: Magma: A Foundation Model for Multimodal AI Agents - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this research, we strive to develop a foundation model for multimodal AI agents and argue that it requires simultaneously possessing the following capabilities: • Multimodal Understanding to understand multimodal input from various domains (both digital and physical) not only semantically, but also spatially and temporally.
